objects.name: data_freshness
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.data_freshness (`measurement_id` UInt32, `target_name` String, `ip_version` String, `latest_measurement_at` Nullable(DateTime64(3, 'Europe/Kyiv')), `data_age_seconds` Nullable(Int64), `measurements_last_5h` UInt64, `probes_observed_last_5h` UInt64, `data_status` String) AS SELECT m.measurement_id, m.target_name, m.ip_version, if(p.measurements = 0, NULL, toTimeZone(p.latest_at, 'Europe/Kyiv')) AS latest_measurement_at, if(p.measurements = 0, NULL, dateDiff('second', p.latest_at, now())) AS data_age_seconds, p.measurements AS measurements_last_5h, p.probes AS probes_observed_last_5h, multiIf(p.measurements = 0, 'Немає даних', dateDiff('second', p.latest_at, now()) > 900, 'Дані застаріли', 'Дані надходять') AS data_status FROM analytics.measurement_directory AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT msm_id, max(event_time) AS latest_at, count() AS measurements, uniqExact(prb_id) AS probes FROM monitoring.ping_results FINAL WHERE event_time >= (now() - toIntervalHour(5)) GROUP BY msm_id) AS p ON p.msm_id = m.measurement_id

objects.name: kpi_directory
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.kpi_directory (`kpi_code` String, `kpi_name` String, `unit` String) AS SELECT 'measurement_count' AS kpi_code, 'Кількість вимірювань' AS kpi_name, 'шт.' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'probes_observed' AS kpi_code, 'Спостережувані зонди' AS kpi_name, 'зондів' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'packets_sent' AS kpi_code, 'Надіслано пакетів' AS kpi_name, 'пакетів' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'packets_received' AS kpi_code, 'Отримано пакетів' AS kpi_name, 'пакетів' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'packets_lost' AS kpi_code, 'Втрачено пакетів' AS kpi_name, 'пакетів' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'packet_loss_pct' AS kpi_code, 'Втрата пакетів' AS kpi_name, '%' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'avg_rtt_ms' AS kpi_code, 'Середня затримка' AS kpi_name, 'мс' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'min_rtt_ms' AS kpi_code, 'Мінімальна затримка' AS kpi_name, 'мс' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'max_rtt_ms' AS kpi_code, 'Максимальна затримка' AS kpi_name, 'мс' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'successful_measurements_pct' AS kpi_code, 'Вимірювання з відповіддю' AS kpi_name, '%' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'high_loss_measurements' AS kpi_code, 'Вимірювання із втратою понад 50%' AS kpi_name, 'шт.' AS unit UNION ALL SELECT 'no_reply_measurements' AS kpi_code, 'Вимірювання без відповіді' AS kpi_name, 'шт.' AS unit

objects.name: measurement_directory
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.measurement_directory (`measurement_id` UInt32, `target_name` String, `target_hostname` String, `ip_version` String, `address_family` UInt8, `interval_seconds` UInt32) AS SELECT toUInt32(1001) AS measurement_id, 'K-root' AS target_name, 'k.root-servers.net' AS target_hostname, 'IPv4' AS ip_version, toUInt8(4) AS address_family, toUInt32(240) AS interval_seconds UNION ALL SELECT toUInt32(2001) AS measurement_id, 'K-root' AS target_name, 'k.root-servers.net' AS target_hostname, 'IPv6' AS ip_version, toUInt8(6) AS address_family, toUInt32(240) AS interval_seconds UNION ALL SELECT toUInt32(1004) AS measurement_id, 'F-root' AS target_name, 'f.root-servers.net' AS target_hostname, 'IPv4' AS ip_version, toUInt8(4) AS address_family, toUInt32(240) AS interval_seconds UNION ALL SELECT toUInt32(2004) AS measurement_id, 'F-root' AS target_name, 'f.root-servers.net' AS target_hostname, 'IPv6' AS ip_version, toUInt8(6) AS address_family, toUInt32(240) AS interval_seconds

objects.name: measurements_live
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.measurements_live (`measured_at` DateTime64(3, 'Europe/Kyiv'), `probe_id` UInt32, `measurement_id` UInt32, `ip_version` String, `target_name` String, `destination_address` Nullable(String), `source_address` Nullable(String), `provider_asn` UInt32, `provider_name` String, `country_code` LowCardinality(String), `latitude` Nullable(Float64), `longitude` Nullable(Float64), `packets_sent` UInt16, `packets_received` UInt16, `packets_lost` Int32, `packet_loss_pct` Float32, `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float32), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float32), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float32), `source_mode` LowCardinality(String), `event_id` String) AS SELECT toTimeZone(p.event_time, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS measured_at, p.prb_id AS probe_id, p.msm_id AS measurement_id, concat('IPv', toString(p.af)) AS ip_version, coalesce(nullIf(m.target_name, ''), p.dst_name, 'Unknown') AS target_name, p.dst_addr AS destination_address, p.src_addr AS source_address, if(p.af = 6, d.asn_v6, d.asn_v4) AS provider_asn, if(provider_asn = 0, 'Невідомий ASN', concat('AS', toString(provider_asn))) AS provider_name, d.country AS country_code, d.latitude, d.longitude, p.sent AS packets_sent, p.rcvd AS packets_received, p.sent - p.rcvd AS packets_lost, p.loss_pct AS packet_loss_pct, p.rtt_avg AS avg_rtt_ms, p.rtt_min AS min_rtt_ms, p.rtt_max AS max_rtt_ms, p.source_mode, p.event_id FROM monitoring.ping_results AS p FINAL LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM monitoring.probe_directory FINAL) AS d ON d.probe_id = p.prb_id LEFT JOIN analytics.measurement_directory AS m ON m.measurement_id = p.msm_id WHERE (p.af IN (4, 6)) AND (p.event_time >= (now() - toIntervalHour(5)))

objects.name: network_5minutes
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.network_5minutes (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `target_name` String, `ip_version` String, `measurement_count` UInt64, `probes_observed` UInt64, `packets_sent` UInt64, `packets_received` UInt64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float32), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float32), `successful_measurements_pct` Float64, `no_reply_measurements` UInt64) AS SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(measured_at) AS period_start, measurement_id, target_name, ip_version, count() AS measurement_count, uniqExact(probe_id) AS probes_observed, sum(q.packets_sent) AS packets_sent, sum(q.packets_received) AS packets_received, (100. * (packets_sent - packets_received)) / nullIf(packets_sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, avg(q.avg_rtt_ms) AS avg_rtt_ms, min(q.min_rtt_ms) AS min_rtt_ms, max(q.max_rtt_ms) AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * countIf(q.packets_received > 0)) / count() AS successful_measurements_pct, countIf(q.packets_received = 0) AS no_reply_measurements FROM analytics.measurements_live AS q GROUP BY period_start, measurement_id, target_name, ip_version

objects.name: network_daily
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.network_daily (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `ip_version` String, `measurement_count` UInt64, `probes_observed` UInt64, `packets_sent` UInt64, `packets_received` UInt64, `packets_lost` Int64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `successful_measurements_pct` Nullable(Float64), `high_loss_measurements` UInt64, `no_reply_measurements` UInt64, `target_name` String) AS SELECT q.*, coalesce(nullIf(m.target_name, ''), concat('RIPE ', toString(q.measurement_id))) AS target_name FROM (SELECT toDateTime(h.day, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS period_start, h.msm_id AS measurement_id, concat('IPv', toString(h.af)) AS ip_version, sum(h.samples) AS measurement_count, uniqExactIf(h.probe_id, h.samples > 0) AS probes_observed, sum(h.sent) AS packets_sent, sum(h.received) AS packets_received, packets_sent - packets_received AS packets_lost, (100. * packets_lost) / nullIf(packets_sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, sum(h.rtt_sum) / nullIf(sum(h.rtt_count), 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, min(h.rtt_min) AS min_rtt_ms, max(h.rtt_max) AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * (measurement_count - sum(h.full_loss_samples))) / nullIf(measurement_count, 0) AS successful_measurements_pct, sum(h.loss_samples) AS high_loss_measurements, sum(h.full_loss_samples) AS no_reply_measurements FROM monitoring.daily_metrics AS h FINAL WHERE (h.af IN (4, 6)) AND (h.msm_id > 0) AND (h.samples > 0) AND 1 GROUP BY period_start, h.msm_id, h.af) AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.measurement_directory AS m ON m.measurement_id = q.measurement_id

objects.name: network_daily_kpi
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.network_daily_kpi (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `target_name` String, `ip_version` String, `kpi_code` String, `kpi_name` String, `unit` String, `value` Nullable(Float64)) AS SELECT q.period_start, q.measurement_id, q.target_name, q.ip_version, metric.1 AS kpi_code, metric.2 AS kpi_name, metric.3 AS unit, metric.4 AS value FROM analytics.network_daily AS q ARRAY JOIN [('measurement_count', 'Кількість вимірювань', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.measurement_count))), ('probes_observed', 'Спостережувані зонди', 'зондів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.probes_observed))), ('packets_sent', 'Надіслано пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_sent))), ('packets_received', 'Отримано пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_received))), ('packets_lost', 'Втрачено пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_lost))), ('packet_loss_pct', 'Втрата пакетів', '%', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packet_loss_pct))), ('avg_rtt_ms', 'Середня затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.avg_rtt_ms))), ('min_rtt_ms', 'Мінімальна затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.min_rtt_ms))), ('max_rtt_ms', 'Максимальна затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.max_rtt_ms))), ('successful_measurements_pct', 'Вимірювання з відповіддю', '%', toNullable(toFloat64(q.successful_measurements_pct))), ('high_loss_measurements', 'Вимірювання із втратою понад 50%', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.high_loss_measurements))), ('no_reply_measurements', 'Вимірювання без відповіді', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.no_reply_measurements)))] AS metric

objects.name: network_hourly
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.network_hourly (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `ip_version` String, `measurement_count` UInt64, `probes_observed` UInt64, `packets_sent` UInt64, `packets_received` UInt64, `packets_lost` Int64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `successful_measurements_pct` Nullable(Float64), `high_loss_measurements` UInt64, `no_reply_measurements` UInt64, `target_name` String) AS SELECT q.*, coalesce(nullIf(m.target_name, ''), concat('RIPE ', toString(q.measurement_id))) AS target_name FROM (SELECT toTimeZone(h.hour_start, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS period_start, h.msm_id AS measurement_id, concat('IPv', toString(h.af)) AS ip_version, sum(h.samples) AS measurement_count, uniqExactIf(h.probe_id, h.samples > 0) AS probes_observed, sum(h.sent) AS packets_sent, sum(h.received) AS packets_received, packets_sent - packets_received AS packets_lost, (100. * packets_lost) / nullIf(packets_sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, sum(h.rtt_sum) / nullIf(sum(h.rtt_count), 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, min(h.rtt_min) AS min_rtt_ms, max(h.rtt_max) AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * (measurement_count - sum(h.full_loss_samples))) / nullIf(measurement_count, 0) AS successful_measurements_pct, sum(h.loss_samples) AS high_loss_measurements, sum(h.full_loss_samples) AS no_reply_measurements FROM monitoring.hourly_metrics AS h FINAL WHERE (h.af IN (4, 6)) AND (h.msm_id > 0) AND (h.samples > 0) AND (h.hour_start >= (now() - toIntervalHour(48))) AND (h.hour_start < toStartOfHour(now())) GROUP BY period_start, h.msm_id, h.af) AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.measurement_directory AS m ON m.measurement_id = q.measurement_id

objects.name: network_hourly_kpi
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.network_hourly_kpi (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `target_name` String, `ip_version` String, `kpi_code` String, `kpi_name` String, `unit` String, `value` Nullable(Float64)) AS SELECT q.period_start, q.measurement_id, q.target_name, q.ip_version, metric.1 AS kpi_code, metric.2 AS kpi_name, metric.3 AS unit, metric.4 AS value FROM analytics.network_hourly AS q ARRAY JOIN [('measurement_count', 'Кількість вимірювань', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.measurement_count))), ('probes_observed', 'Спостережувані зонди', 'зондів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.probes_observed))), ('packets_sent', 'Надіслано пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_sent))), ('packets_received', 'Отримано пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_received))), ('packets_lost', 'Втрачено пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_lost))), ('packet_loss_pct', 'Втрата пакетів', '%', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packet_loss_pct))), ('avg_rtt_ms', 'Середня затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.avg_rtt_ms))), ('min_rtt_ms', 'Мінімальна затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.min_rtt_ms))), ('max_rtt_ms', 'Максимальна затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.max_rtt_ms))), ('successful_measurements_pct', 'Вимірювання з відповіддю', '%', toNullable(toFloat64(q.successful_measurements_pct))), ('high_loss_measurements', 'Вимірювання із втратою понад 50%', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.high_loss_measurements))), ('no_reply_measurements', 'Вимірювання без відповіді', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.no_reply_measurements)))] AS metric

objects.name: probe_directory
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.probe_directory (`probe_id` UInt32, `country_code` LowCardinality(String), `ipv4_provider_asn` UInt32, `ipv6_provider_asn` UInt32, `latitude` Nullable(Float64), `longitude` Nullable(Float64), `atlas_status` String) AS SELECT probe_id, country AS country_code, asn_v4 AS ipv4_provider_asn, asn_v6 AS ipv6_provider_asn, latitude, longitude, status AS atlas_status FROM monitoring.probe_directory FINAL

objects.name: probe_events_live
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.probe_events_live (`event_at` DateTime64(3, 'Europe/Kyiv'), `probe_id` UInt32, `connection_event` LowCardinality(String), `event_id` String) AS SELECT toTimeZone(event_time, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS event_at, prb_id AS probe_id, event AS connection_event, event_id FROM monitoring.probe_events FINAL WHERE event_time >= (now() - toIntervalHour(5))

objects.name: probes_daily
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.probes_daily (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `ip_version` String, `provider_asn` UInt32, `probe_id` UInt32, `measurement_count` UInt64, `probes_observed` UInt64, `packets_sent` UInt64, `packets_received` UInt64, `packets_lost` Int64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `successful_measurements_pct` Nullable(Float64), `high_loss_measurements` UInt64, `no_reply_measurements` UInt64, `provider_name` String, `target_name` String) AS SELECT q.*, if(q.provider_asn = 0, 'Невідомий ASN', concat('AS', toString(q.provider_asn))) AS provider_name, coalesce(nullIf(m.target_name, ''), concat('RIPE ', toString(q.measurement_id))) AS target_name FROM (SELECT toDateTime(h.day, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS period_start, h.msm_id AS measurement_id, concat('IPv', toString(h.af)) AS ip_version, h.asn AS provider_asn, h.probe_id AS probe_id, sum(h.samples) AS measurement_count, uniqExactIf(h.probe_id, h.samples > 0) AS probes_observed, sum(h.sent) AS packets_sent, sum(h.received) AS packets_received, packets_sent - packets_received AS packets_lost, (100. * packets_lost) / nullIf(packets_sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, sum(h.rtt_sum) / nullIf(sum(h.rtt_count), 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, min(h.rtt_min) AS min_rtt_ms, max(h.rtt_max) AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * (measurement_count - sum(h.full_loss_samples))) / nullIf(measurement_count, 0) AS successful_measurements_pct, sum(h.loss_samples) AS high_loss_measurements, sum(h.full_loss_samples) AS no_reply_measurements FROM monitoring.daily_metrics AS h FINAL WHERE (h.af IN (4, 6)) AND (h.msm_id > 0) AND (h.samples > 0) AND 1 GROUP BY period_start, h.msm_id, h.af, h.asn, h.probe_id) AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.measurement_directory AS m ON m.measurement_id = q.measurement_id

objects.name: probes_daily_kpi
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.probes_daily_kpi (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `target_name` String, `ip_version` String, `provider_asn` UInt32, `provider_name` String, `probe_id` UInt32, `kpi_code` String, `kpi_name` String, `unit` String, `value` Nullable(Float64)) AS SELECT q.period_start, q.measurement_id, q.target_name, q.ip_version, q.provider_asn, q.provider_name, q.probe_id, metric.1 AS kpi_code, metric.2 AS kpi_name, metric.3 AS unit, metric.4 AS value FROM analytics.probes_daily AS q ARRAY JOIN [('measurement_count', 'Кількість вимірювань', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.measurement_count))), ('packets_sent', 'Надіслано пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_sent))), ('packets_received', 'Отримано пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_received))), ('packets_lost', 'Втрачено пакетів', 'пакетів', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packets_lost))), ('packet_loss_pct', 'Втрата пакетів', '%', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packet_loss_pct))), ('avg_rtt_ms', 'Середня затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.avg_rtt_ms))), ('min_rtt_ms', 'Мінімальна затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.min_rtt_ms))), ('max_rtt_ms', 'Максимальна затримка', 'мс', toNullable(toFloat64(q.max_rtt_ms))), ('successful_measurements_pct', 'Вимірювання з відповіддю', '%', toNullable(toFloat64(q.successful_measurements_pct))), ('high_loss_measurements', 'Вимірювання із втратою понад 50%', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.high_loss_measurements))), ('no_reply_measurements', 'Вимірювання без відповіді', 'шт.', toNullable(toFloat64(q.no_reply_measurements)))] AS metric

objects.name: probes_hourly
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW analytics.probes_hourly (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `measurement_id` UInt32, `ip_version` String, `provider_asn` UInt32, `probe_id` UInt32, `measurement_count` UInt64, `probes_observed` UInt64, `packets_sent` UInt64, `packets_received` UInt64, `packets_lost` Int64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `successful_measurements_pct` Nullable(Float64), `high_loss_measurements` UInt64, `no_reply_measurements` UInt64, `provider_name` String, `target_name` String) AS SELECT q.*, if(q.provider_asn = 0, 'Невідомий ASN', concat('AS', toString(q.provider_asn))) AS provider_name, coalesce(nullIf(m.target_name, ''), concat('RIPE ', toString(q.measurement_id))) AS target_name FROM (SELECT toTimeZone(h.hour_start, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS period_start, h.msm_id AS measurement_id, concat('IPv', toString(h.af)) AS ip_version, h.asn AS provider_asn, h.probe_id AS probe_id, sum(h.samples) AS measurement_count, uniqExactIf(h.probe_id, h.samples > 0) AS probes_observed, sum(h.sent) AS packets_sent, sum(h.received) AS packets_received, packets_sent - packets_received AS packets_lost, (100. * packets_lost) / nullIf(packets_sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, sum(h.rtt_sum) / nullIf(sum(h.rtt_count), 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, min(h.rtt_min) AS min_rtt_ms, max(h.rtt_max) AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * (measurement_count - sum(h.full_loss_samples))) / nullIf(measurement_count, 0) AS successful_measurements_pct, sum(h.loss_samples) AS high_loss_measurements, sum(h.full_loss_samples) AS no_reply_measurements FROM monitoring.hourly_metrics AS h FINAL WHERE (h.af IN (4, 6)) AND (h.msm_id > 0) AND (h.samples > 0) AND (h.hour_start >= (now() - toIntervalHour(48))) AND (h.hour_start < toStartOfHour(now())) GROUP BY period_start, h.msm_id, h.af, h.asn, h.probe_id) AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.measurement_directory AS m ON m.measurement_id = q.measurement_id

objects.name: probes_hourly_kpi

objects.name: daily_kpi
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.daily_kpi (`period_start` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `period_end` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `period_name_uk` String, `period_label` String, `probe_id` UInt32, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `kpi_code` String, `kpi_name_uk` String, `kpi_value` Nullable(Float64), `unit_uk` String) AS SELECT toDateTime(q.day, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS period_start, toDateTime(addDays(q.day, 1), 'Europe/Kyiv') AS period_end, q.period_name_uk, q.period_label, q.probe_id, q.msm_id, q.af, q.asn, d.kpi_code, d.kpi_name_uk, metric.2 AS kpi_value, d.unit_uk FROM (SELECT v.*, h.loss_samples, h.full_loss_samples FROM monitoring.daily_network_metrics AS v INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM monitoring.daily_metrics FINAL) AS h USING (day, probe_id, msm_id, af, asn)) AS q ARRAY JOIN [('samples', toNullable(toFloat64(q.samples))), ('sent', toNullable(toFloat64(q.sent))), ('received', toNullable(toFloat64(q.received))), ('packets_lost', toNullable(toFloat64(q.sent - q.received))), ('packet_loss_pct', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packet_loss_pct))), ('avg_rtt_ms', toNullable(toFloat64(q.avg_rtt_ms))), ('min_rtt_ms', toNullable(toFloat64(q.min_rtt_ms))), ('max_rtt_ms', toNullable(toFloat64(q.max_rtt_ms))), ('measurement_success_pct', toNullable(toFloat64(q.measurement_success_pct))), ('loss_samples', toNullable(toFloat64(q.loss_samples))), ('full_loss_samples', toNullable(toFloat64(q.full_loss_samples)))] AS metric INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM monitoring.kpi_dictionary FINAL) AS d ON d.kpi_code = (metric.1)

objects.name: daily_metrics
objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.daily_metrics (`day` Date, `probe_id` UInt32, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `samples` UInt64, `sent` UInt64, `received` UInt64, `rtt_sum` Float64, `rtt_count` UInt64, `rtt_min` Nullable(Float64), `rtt_max` Nullable(Float64), `normal_rtt_sum` Float64, `normal_rtt_count` UInt64, `loss_samples` UInt64, `full_loss_samples` UInt64, `connects` UInt64, `disconnects` UInt64, `version` UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(version) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(day) ORDER BY (day, probe_id, msm_id, af, asn) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: daily_network_metrics
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.daily_network_metrics (`day` Date, `probe_id` UInt32, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `samples` UInt64, `sent` UInt64, `received` UInt64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `measurement_success_pct` Nullable(Float64), `connects` UInt64, `disconnects` UInt64, `period_name_uk` String, `period_label` String) AS SELECT q.*, 'Поденні дані' AS period_name_uk, formatDateTime(toDateTime(q.day), '%d.%m.%Y') AS period_label FROM (SELECT day, probe_id, msm_id, af, asn, samples, sent, received, (100. * (sent - received)) / nullIf(sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, rtt_sum / nullIf(rtt_count, 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, rtt_min AS min_rtt_ms, rtt_max AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * (samples - full_loss_samples)) / nullIf(samples, 0) AS measurement_success_pct, connects, disconnects FROM monitoring.daily_metrics FINAL WHERE af > 0) AS q

objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.daily_probe_activity (`day` Date, `probe_id` UInt32, `asn` UInt32, `connects` UInt64, `disconnects` UInt64) AS SELECT day, probe_id, asn, connects, disconnects FROM monitoring.daily_metrics FINAL WHERE af = 0

objects.name: daily_provider_metrics

objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.hourly_metrics (`hour_start` DateTime('UTC'), `probe_id` UInt32, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `samples` UInt64, `sent` UInt64, `received` UInt64, `rtt_sum` Float64, `rtt_count` UInt64, `rtt_min` Nullable(Float64), `rtt_max` Nullable(Float64), `normal_rtt_sum` Float64, `normal_rtt_count` UInt64, `loss_samples` UInt64, `full_loss_samples` UInt64, `connects` UInt64, `disconnects` UInt64, `version` UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(version) PARTITION BY toDate(hour_start) ORDER BY (hour_start, probe_id, msm_id, af, asn) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: hourly_network_metrics
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.hourly_network_metrics (`hour_start` DateTime('UTC'), `local_hour` DateTime('Europe/Kyiv'), `probe_id` UInt32, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `samples` UInt64, `sent` UInt64, `received` UInt64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `min_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `max_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `measurement_success_pct` Nullable(Float64), `connects` UInt64, `disconnects` UInt64, `period_name_uk` String, `period_label` String) AS SELECT q.*, 'Погодинні дані' AS period_name_uk, formatDateTime(toTimeZone(q.hour_start, 'Europe/Kyiv'), '%d.%m.%Y %H:%i %z') AS period_label FROM (SELECT hour_start, toTimeZone(hour_start, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS local_hour, probe_id, msm_id, af, asn, samples, sent, received, (100. * (sent - received)) / nullIf(sent, 0) AS packet_loss_pct, rtt_sum / nullIf(rtt_count, 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, rtt_min AS min_rtt_ms, rtt_max AS max_rtt_ms, (100. * (samples - full_loss_samples)) / nullIf(samples, 0) AS measurement_success_pct, connects, disconnects FROM monitoring.hourly_metrics FINAL WHERE (af > 0) AND (hour_start >= (now() - toIntervalDay(2))) AND (hour_start < toStartOfHour(now()))) AS q

objects.name: hourly_provider_kpi
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.hourly_provider_kpi (`period_start` DateTime('UTC'), `period_end` DateTime('UTC'), `period_name_uk` String, `period_label` String, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `kpi_code` String, `kpi_name_uk` String, `kpi_value` Nullable(Float64), `unit_uk` String) AS SELECT q.hour_start AS period_start, q.hour_start + toIntervalHour(1) AS period_end, q.period_name_uk, q.period_label, q.msm_id, q.af, q.asn, d.kpi_code, d.kpi_name_uk, metric.2 AS kpi_value, d.unit_uk FROM (SELECT * FROM monitoring.hourly_provider_metrics) AS q ARRAY JOIN [('observed_probes', toNullable(toFloat64(q.observed_probes))), ('samples', toNullable(toFloat64(q.samples))), ('packet_loss_pct', toNullable(toFloat64(q.packet_loss_pct))), ('avg_rtt_ms', toNullable(toFloat64(q.avg_rtt_ms)))] AS metric INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM monitoring.kpi_dictionary FINAL) AS d ON d.kpi_code = (metric.1)

objects.name: hourly_provider_metrics
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.hourly_provider_metrics (`hour_start` DateTime('UTC'), `asn` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `msm_id` UInt32, `observed_probes` UInt64, `samples` UInt64, `packet_loss_pct` Nullable(Float64), `avg_rtt_ms` Nullable(Float64), `disconnects` UInt64, `period_name_uk` String, `period_label` String) AS SELECT q.*, 'Погодинні дані' AS period_name_uk, formatDateTime(toTimeZone(q.hour_start, 'Europe/Kyiv'), '%d.%m.%Y %H:%i %z') AS period_label FROM (SELECT hour_start, asn, af, msm_id, uniqExact(probe_id) AS observed_probes, sum(samples) AS samples, (100. * (sum(sent) - sum(received))) / nullIf(sum(sent), 0) AS packet_loss_pct, sum(rtt_sum) / nullIf(sum(rtt_count), 0) AS avg_rtt_ms, sum(disconnects) AS disconnects FROM monitoring.hourly_metrics FINAL WHERE (af > 0) AND (hour_start >= (now() - toIntervalDay(2))) AND (hour_start < toStartOfHour(now())) GROUP BY hour_start, asn, af, msm_id) AS q

objects.name: kpi_dictionary
objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.kpi_dictionary (`kpi_code` String, `kpi_name_uk` String, `unit_uk` String, `description_uk` String) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY kpi_code SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: live_network_measurements
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.live_network_measurements (`event_id` String, `event_time` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `local_time` DateTime64(3, 'Europe/Kyiv'), `probe_id` UInt32, `msm_id` UInt32, `af` UInt8, `asn` UInt32, `country` LowCardinality(String), `latitude` Nullable(Float64), `longitude` Nullable(Float64), `rtt_ms` Nullable(Float32), `packet_loss_pct` Float32, `sent` UInt16, `received` UInt16, `target` Nullable(String), `source_mode` LowCardinality(String)) AS SELECT r.event_id, r.event_time, toTimeZone(r.event_time, 'Europe/Kyiv') AS local_time, r.prb_id AS probe_id, r.msm_id, r.af, if(r.af = 6, p.asn_v6, p.asn_v4) AS asn, p.country, p.latitude, p.longitude, r.rtt_avg AS rtt_ms, r.loss_pct AS packet_loss_pct, r.sent, r.rcvd AS received, r.dst_name AS target, r.source_mode FROM (SELECT * FROM monitoring.ping_results FINAL WHERE event_time >= (now() - toIntervalHour(5))) AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM monitoring.probe_directory FINAL) AS p ON p.probe_id = r.prb_id

objects.name: ping_ingest_trigger
objects.create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW monitoring.ping_ingest_trigger TO monitoring.retention_runs (`key` String, `value` String, `version` UInt64) AS SELECT 'ingest_request' AS key, toString(max(ingested_at)) AS value, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64(9))) AS version FROM monitoring.ping_results

objects.name: ping_results
objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.ping_results (`event_id` String, `msm_id` UInt32, `prb_id` UInt32, `event_time` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `af` UInt8, `sent` UInt16, `rcvd` UInt16, `loss_pct` Float32, `rtt_min` Nullable(Float32), `rtt_avg` Nullable(Float32), `rtt_max` Nullable(Float32), `dst_name` Nullable(String), `dst_addr` Nullable(String), `src_addr` Nullable(String), `source_mode` LowCardinality(String), `ingested_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3)) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ingested_at) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(event_time) ORDER BY (msm_id, prb_id, event_time, event_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: probe_directory
objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.probe_directory (`probe_id` UInt32, `country` LowCardinality(String), `asn_v4` UInt32, `asn_v6` UInt32, `latitude` Nullable(Float64), `longitude` Nullable(Float64), `status` String, `version` UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(version) ORDER BY probe_id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: probe_events
objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.probe_events (`event_id` String, `prb_id` UInt32, `event_time` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `event` LowCardinality(String), `ingested_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3)) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ingested_at) PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(event_time) ORDER BY (prb_id, event_time, event_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: raw_ping_last_5h
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.raw_ping_last_5h (`event_id` String, `msm_id` UInt32, `prb_id` UInt32, `event_time` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `af` UInt8, `sent` UInt16, `rcvd` UInt16, `loss_pct` Float32, `rtt_min` Nullable(Float32), `rtt_avg` Nullable(Float32), `rtt_max` Nullable(Float32), `dst_name` Nullable(String), `dst_addr` Nullable(String), `src_addr` Nullable(String), `source_mode` LowCardinality(String), `ingested_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC')) AS SELECT * FROM monitoring.ping_results FINAL WHERE event_time >= (now() - toIntervalHour(5))

objects.name: raw_probe_events_last_5h
objects.create_table_query: CREATE VIEW monitoring.raw_probe_events_last_5h (`event_id` String, `prb_id` UInt32, `event_time` DateTime64(3, 'UTC'), `event` LowCardinality(String), `ingested_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC')) AS SELECT * FROM monitoring.probe_events FINAL WHERE event_time >= (now() - toIntervalHour(5))

objects.name: retention_runs
objects.create_table_query: CREATE TABLE monitoring.retention_runs (`key` String, `value` String, `version` UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(version) ORDER BY key SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

objects.name: status_ingest_trigger
objects.create_table_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW monitoring.status_ingest_trigger TO monitoring.retention_runs (`key` String, `value` String, `version` UInt64) AS SELECT 'status_ingest_request' AS key, toString(max(ingested_at)) AS value, toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(now64(9))) AS version FROM monitoring.probe_events

constraints.name: telegram_deliveries_outbox_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (outbox_id) REFERENCES telegram_outbox(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

views.name: incident_episode_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT kind,
    scope,
    opened_at,
    last_seen_at,
    resolved_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (resolved_at IS NULL) THEN 'Триває'::text
            ELSE 'Відновлено'::text
        END AS status_uk,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(resolved_at, now()) - opened_at)) AS duration_seconds,
    severity,
    details,
    opening_id
   FROM incident_episodes;

views.name: incident_history_metrics
views.definition:
SELECT episode_id,
    kind,
    scope,
    min(event_time) AS opened_at,
    max(resolved_at) AS resolved_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (max(resolved_at) IS NULL) THEN 'Триває'::text
            ELSE 'Відновлено'::text
        END AS status_uk,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(max(resolved_at), now()) - min(event_time))) AS duration_seconds
   FROM monitoring_incidents
  WHERE ((episode_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind <> 'RECOVERED'::text))
  GROUP BY episode_id, kind, scope;

views.name: processing_error_summary
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, received_at) AS hour_start,
    stage,
    reason,
    count(*) AS rejected_events
   FROM processing_errors
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, received_at)), stage, reason;

views.name: incidents
views.definition:
SELECT incident_id,
    COALESCE(episode_id, incident_id) AS episode_id,
    first_event_time AS started_at,
    resolved_at,
    kind AS incident_type,
    scope,
    severity,
        CASE
            WHEN (kind = 'RECOVERED'::text) THEN 'Повідомлення про відновлення'::text
            WHEN (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Відновлено'::text
            ELSE 'Триває'::text
        END AS incident_status,
    (NULLIF((details ->> 'probe_id'::text), ''::text))::bigint AS probe_id,
    (NULLIF((details ->> 'asn'::text), ''::text))::bigint AS provider_asn,
    (NULLIF((details ->> 'msm_id'::text), ''::text))::integer AS measurement_id,
        CASE (details ->> 'af'::text)
            WHEN '4'::text THEN 'IPv4'::text
            WHEN '6'::text THEN 'IPv6'::text
            ELSE 'Не застосовується'::text
        END AS ip_version,
    notification_status
   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(monitoring_incidents.episode_id, monitoring_incidents.incident_id)) monitoring_incidents.incident_id,
            monitoring_incidents.kind,
            monitoring_incidents.scope,
            monitoring_incidents.event_time,
            monitoring_incidents.severity,
            monitoring_incidents.details,
            monitoring_incidents.notification_status,
            monitoring_incidents.created_at,
            monitoring_incidents.resolved_at,
            monitoring_incidents.episode_id,
            min(monitoring_incidents.event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(monitoring_incidents.episode_id, monitoring_incidents.incident_id)) AS first_event_time
           FROM monitoring_incidents
          WHERE (monitoring_incidents.kind <> 'RECOVERED'::text)
          ORDER BY COALESCE(monitoring_incidents.episode_id, monitoring_incidents.incident_id), monitoring_incidents.event_time DESC) episodes;

views.name: incidents_daily
views.definition:
SELECT ((started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv'::text))::date AS day,
    incident_type,
    ip_version,
    measurement_id,
    count(DISTINCT episode_id) AS incident_count
   FROM reporting.incidents
  WHERE (incident_type <> 'RECOVERED'::text)
  GROUP BY (((started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv'::text))::date), incident_type, ip_version, measurement_id;

views.name: incidents_hourly
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, started_at) AS period_start,
    incident_type,
    severity,
    ip_version,
    measurement_id,
    count(DISTINCT episode_id) AS incident_count
   FROM reporting.incidents
  WHERE (incident_type <> 'RECOVERED'::text)
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, started_at)), incident_type, severity, ip_version, measurement_id;

views.name: processing_errors_hourly
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, received_at) AS period_start,
    stage,
    reason,
    count(*) AS rejected_events
   FROM processing_errors
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, received_at)), stage, reason;

views.name: telegram_deliveries_daily
views.definition:
SELECT ((o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv'::text))::date AS day,
    d.status AS delivery_status,
    count(*) AS delivery_count
   FROM (telegram_deliveries d
     JOIN telegram_outbox o ON ((o.id = d.outbox_id)))
  GROUP BY (((o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv'::text))::date), d.status;
